name: zinput_keyboard_is_unsuspended
description: zInputKeyboard::IsUnsuspended reports whether the keyboard suspend flag is clear.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence validates this no-callee leaf reads the keyboard suspend flag and returns 1 only when the suspend bit is clear.
The native smoke verifies the unsuspended and suspended states for mouse, joystick, and keyboard suspend flags.
